result.summary: The food delivery homepage is generally well-designed and functional. The main visual issue is horizontal truncation of content in the 'Fastest near you' carousel (the third card 'Trattoria Piccol...' is cut off at the right edge), which is expected carousel behavior but the card title is clipped mid-word without a clear visual affordance. Other elements are minor cosmetic observations.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel, the third restaurant card ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right screen edge with its title truncated mid-word. While this signals scrollability, there is no explicit scroll indicator or peek padding to make the affordance obvious.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade gradient or a small scroll hint, and ensure truncated titles use an ellipsis at a word boundary rather than clipping mid-word.

issues.description: The search placeholder text reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' which appears to be a misspelling of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the spelling to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is also cut off at the right edge with a partially visible chip, which is acceptable for a scrollable row but lacks a visual cue that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade or ensure the next chip peeks in more clearly to indicate horizontal scrolling.
